title: The Swiss Clock That Ran Backwards Forever

basis.note: median of recent videos blended with the niche benchmark; learning gated until day 5

predicted_range.basis: about 3x either way, from backtested error (99 of our own videos so far)

segments.narration: Every gear inside the ancient Swiss clock reversed direction simultaneously. No sparks flew. No alarms rang out across the quiet medieval square.
In 1998, technicians at the Zytglogge tower in Bern stripped the iron casing and found zero broken teeth or jammed springs. Every single wheel turned smoothly backward.
How do hundreds of pounds of interlocking brass and iron unmake their own momentum without breaking a single tooth?
Detailed diagnostics later revealed that a modern digital motor control system had been covertly retrofitted behind the iron dial.
The impossible reversal was actually an unauthorized artistic stunt pulled by a local horologist. But why did he risk prison just to make time run backward for a single afternoon?
